description: Appeal filed five months after service of the OIO — outside the three-month period under Section 107(1) and beyond the condonable one-month window under Section 107(4). Procedural_stickler persona should refuse to advance to merits until limitation is addressed.

variables.MATTER_TITLE: M/s Sunrise Polymers Pvt. Ltd. v. Deputy Commissioner, CGST Pune-II
variables.OIO_TEXT: OIO No. 47/2024 dated 14 October 2024. Demand of CGST INR 18,42,750 and SGST INR 18,42,750 confirmed under Section 74 for FY 2020-21 on the ground of suppression of outward supplies in GSTR-1 vis-a-vis books. Interest under Section 50 and penalty equal to tax under Section 74(1) confirmed.
variables.GOA_TEXT: Ground 1: There is no suppression; the differences are reconciling items between provisional and final invoices. Ground 2: Show-cause notice was time-barred for FY 2020-21 under Section 74(10). Ground 3: Cross-examination of the departmental investigator was sought and denied, violating principles of natural justice.
variables.WS_TEXT: Written submissions filed on the date of hearing reiterate Grounds 1-3 and place a 12-page reconciliation chart for the disputed period.
variables.EVIDENCE_INDEX: Annexure 1: GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B for FY 2020-21. Annexure 2: Books reconciliation chart. Annexure 3: Show-cause notice. Annexure 4: Reply to SCN.
variables.CITED_AUTHORITIES: 1. The settled principle that limitation under Section 107 runs from the date of communication of the order, not the date of the order itself.
variables.PREDEPOSIT_TEXT: Pre-deposit of 10% paid vide DRC-03 dated 12 March 2025.
variables.LIMITATION_TEXT: OIO date: 14 October 2024. Service date: 18 October 2024. Appeal filed: 21 March 2025. Filed beyond three months under Section 107(1) and beyond the condonable one-month window under Section 107(4). Application for condonation under Section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963 also filed.
variables.MISC_ORDERS: Application under Rule 112 to place a cross-examination request pending.
